|game_text=Deploy on table. Your [[Sandwhirl]] is canceled. At battleground systems where you have a Rebel of ability = 2 piloting a starfighter, and you have no Force drain bonus (except from the system card itself), your Force drains are +1. Your starfighters with a pilot character aboard are immune to attrition < 4. Once per turn, may ▼ [[Close Air Support]]. Your Rebel starfighters without astromech capacit (except ''Falcon'' or [[Artoo-Detoo In Red 5]]) gain "May add 1 astromech."
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Rebel Aces]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB7-02-Rebel_Aces-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Rebel Aces]] (original, release sheet of 18 June 2010); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Rebel Aces (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Rebel Aces (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Rebel Aces]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010, slip 45; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010), page 8, slip 45 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Your [[Sandwhirl]] is canceled. At battleground systems where you have a Rebel of ability = 2 piloting a starfighter, and you have no Force drain bonus (except from the system card itself), your Force drains are +1. Your starfighters with a pilot character aboard are immune to attrition < 4. Once per turn, may ▼ [[Close Air Support]]. Your Rebel starfighters without astromech capacity (except ''Falcon'' or [[Artoo-Detoo In Red 5]]) gain "May add 1 astromech."” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 46)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=46, page 46. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=46 Internet Archive]</ref> prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Rebel Aces (Errata 3)]]), and the current text. The wiki's copy of the release-sheet slip is cut off below the art, so its slip number cannot be read.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) spells “astromech capacit” (typo as published). PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1271_45">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy on table. Your [[Sandwhirl]] is canceled. At battleground systems where you have a Rebel of ability = 2 piloting a starfighter, and you have no Force drain bonus (except from the system card itself), your Force drains are +1. Your starfighters with a pilot character aboard are immune to attrition < 4. Once per turn, may ▼ [[Close Air Support]]. Your Rebel starfighters without astromech capacit (except ''Falcon'' or [[Artoo-Detoo In Red 5]]) gain "May add 1 astromech."” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card list writes the quotation in single quotes (its HTML cannot hold double quotes); the printed double quotes are kept. The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Rebel Aces (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-rebelaces-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Rebel Aces]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Your [[Sandwhirl]] is canceled. At battleground systems where you have a Rebel of ability = 2 piloting a starfighter, and you have no Force drain bonus (except from the system card itself), your Force drains are +1. Your starfighters with a pilot character aboard are immune to attrition < 4. Once per turn, may ▼ [[Close Air Support]]. Your Rebel starfighters without astromech capacity (except ''Falcon'' or [[Artoo-Detoo In Red 5]]) gain "May add 1 astromech."” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “45” at the bottom right (the release-sheet slip: “?”).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Rebel Aces (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 46)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Rebel Aces]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Your [[Sandwhirl]] is canceled. At battleground systems where you have a Rebel of ability = 2 piloting a starfighter, and you have no Force drain bonus (except from the system card itself), your Force drains are +1. Your starfighters with a pilot character aboard are immune to attrition < 4. Once per turn, may ▼ [[Close Air Support]]. Your Rebel starfighters without astromech capacity (except ''Falcon'' or [[Artoo-Detoo In Red 5]]) gain "May add 1 astromech."” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1271-45-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image do). The wiki's copy of the release-sheet slip is cut off below the art, so its slip number cannot be read.
